content: Kodi cloud-drive addon landscape is dominated by the cguZZman family (plugin.googledrive, plugin.onedrive, plugin.dropbox, plugin.amazonclouddrive) sharing script.module.clouddrive.common; upstream last pushed 2023-01-21 and is effectively unmaintained. plugin.googledrive advertises: Unlimited accounts, Team Drives, Google Photos, video+music+picture playback with thumbnails, search over the drive, automatic subtitle assignment when a same-named subtitle file exists, export to library as .strm, slideshow with auto-refresh, and OAuth2 login without entering user/password in the addon. The Use-Drive-as-a-source feature is documented as NOT currently working. Kodi wiki documents account addition as: choose Add an account, scan the QR code or go to the displayed login page and enter the generated code. Multi-account is therefore a headline, advertised feature across the category. Older alternatives (ddurdle plugin.video.gdrive, sysbot amazon-cloud-drive-for-kodi) are abandoned.
